text: When a Gowin FIR is over a 4-DSP budget (8 DSP, 165.9 MHz, carry-chain sum_r[9] 6.03 ns at non-symmetric fold=1), switching to symmetric fold=2 with reg_in and two post-multiplier stages meets 4 DSP but lengthens the folded accumulator carry chain to 10.31 ns (5.6 ns logic + 3.85 ns route on out_data), dropping Fmax to 96.9 MHz and adding 291 LUTs, so pipeline or split that accumulator rather than spending registers only on multiplier input/output.

When a 4-DSP folded symmetric FIR on Gowin misses timing with the critical path through the 32-cell out_data carry chain and an extra DSP-output register, drop pipe_mul from 2 to 1 and set dsp_regs to none to cut carry-chain route delay 3.85→3.22 ns, lifting Fmax 96.9→103.1 MHz (+6.2) at unchanged 775 LUT/4 DSP and making 100 MHz feasible.

When a Gowin folded symmetric FIR at fold=2 is limited by the out_data accumulator carry chain (5.62 ns logic + 3.22 ns route of a 9.70 ns path) while DSP count and throughput are already fixed, shrink acc_width from 32 to the exact 29-bit minimum (12+12+4+1) to cut the chain from 32 to 30 cells, gaining +0.38 MHz and -42 LUT at 0 DSP penalty.

When a Gowin FIR on a 4-DSP budget is infeasible because non-symmetric fold=1 needs 8 MULT18X18 and its 6.02 ns critical path is the sum_r[11] carry chain, switch to symmetric fold=2 with a 29-bit accumulator and one post-multiplier register; it drops to 4 DSPs and becomes feasible at 103.5 MHz (-62.7 MHz), but the folded form moves the limiter to the out_data carry chain (9.66 ns = 5.58 ns logic + 3.23 ns route, 30 cells).

When a Gowin transposed FIR is DSP-count-infeasible (8 MULT18X18 vs a 4-DSP cap) but timing-rich at 166.2 MHz, switch to symmetric fold=2 with a 29-bit accumulator, registered input, and a post-multiplier fabric register while keeping the accumulator out of the DSP, which halves to 4 DSP and, although the out_data carry chain grows to 9.66 ns (5.58 ns logic + 3.23 ns route over 30 cells), lands at 103.5 MHz—feasible against 100 MHz—for +249 LUT and -62.7 MHz.
